text:
Casey Lin: Pizza crawl idea  hit three spots on the boardwalk then finish at Tilted Alley for pinball? start 6pm? :pizza::joystick:
Vera Gomez: LOVE. how many slices per stop is realistic?
Casey Lin: thinking 1-2 shares per person per stop, hop every 45 mins.
Drew Patel: pinball end is 👌. can we reserve machines?
Molly Hart: Tilted Alley said they take small group holds after 8pm.
Ethan Zhou: can we do a low-key poll: :pizza: for pizza crawl + pinball, :beer: just pizza & drinks, :game_die: skip pinball and do boardgames at the last stop? react with emoji.
Vera Gomez: :pizza:
Drew Patel: :pizza:
Molly Hart: :game_die: (might bring Chronicle)
Casey Lin: RSVP so far Casey, Vera, Drew, Molly, Ethan. bringing guests ok but mark in RSVP.
Drew Patel: dietary notes: gluten-free crust option pls.
Casey Lin: noted  i'll call the first spot to confirm GF slices.
Molly Hart: logistics Q  anyone need a ride from Midtown? i have two seats.
Ethan Zhou: might take you up on that, thanks.
Casey Lin: can someone add to calendar? i'm terrible with multi-stop plans.
calendar-bot: Event created "Boardwalk Pizza Crawl + Pinball" Saturday 6:00 PM. RSVP: https://cal.example.com/event/3347
Casey Lin: link above, please RSVP and indicate +1s and GF needs. see u there! :sparkles:
